 Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers

Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1083 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client, Lindsey Smith, regarding injuries sustained in a collision that occurred in a parking lot on
April 10, 2023. Our clinet was stopped and waiting for a parked vehicle to celar a space when your insured's vehicle backed into
the driver's side of our client's car. The impact was sufficient to deploy airbag components and to damage both vehicles, and the
responding officer documented the scene.
Our client immediately experienced neck pain, stiffness, and headaches. Medical evaluation confirmed a whiplash-type cervical
strain. Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed medication, and restrictions on lifting and driving that have interfered
with our client's work and daily routine. Medical records and billing statements are enclosed, along with a summary of lost
wages.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to keep a proper lookout while reversing and is responsible for the harm that
followed. We ask that your company review the enclosed materials and respond within thirty days. Our client is prepared to
resolve this claim for $180,000.00, which reflects medical expenses, lost income, and compensation for pain and suffering. If we
do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Jessica Herrera, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Andrew Lewis
Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
